review_description: Rod knows what he is doing and he can give you the best and most productive solar system for your property, unlike lots of other companies who just want to sell their products.

Very happy with Rod and his team for the installation work they completed. Rod is friendly, helpful and is a person who is very proud of his work and enjoys his job. It is rare to find someone who takes all the above pride in their work. Would recommend Rod 100%.

We have had a problem with another company that did not honour their warranty. We contacted Rod and were very pleased with his great service, prompt response to our problem. Replacement inverter supplied and installed in a week.Thank you very much Rod for your honest, reliable and friendly service .I would recommend Western Sydney Solar for new installs, service or repairs.

Quoting was only provided after a comprehensive site inspection.The installation went well even though it was raining and made the installation slower with regard to site safety. All aspects of the install was explained in detail. The site was left as found and the guys turned up on time every time.The quote covered all aspects of the complete install and we had nothing to do ourselves as Rod had it all in hand great Customer Service the likes of which I have not seen in a long time. Thanks.
Excellent workmanship with attention to detail. A very rare find these days. M

Rod is the most knowledgeable and informed person, on all things Solar, that I have had the pleasure of speaking to.His was punctual, reliable and professional and the quote was explained in terms I could understand and supplied in a timely manner.The team arrived on site on the day agreed. The work was carried out with a minimum of fuss and was at all times clean and tidy.Once the installation was completed, Rod sat down with me and explained how the Solar Analytics program worked. I have had much fun learning how to use it to my advantage.Rod keeps an eye on my system and recently advised me that the plan I chose had been improved and suggested I contact my supplier to get the better deal. Again helping me to save more from my new Solar installation.Anyone considering Solar installation could not do better than contacting Western Sydney Solar.

I had a great experience with Western Sydney Solar from start to finish. Rod's solar industry knowledge is simply outstanding !!! He was polite, friendly, & always kept me informed regarding the installation schedule. Even his after sales service is excellent, as I had a problem with the location of the inverter (not his fault) & he went above & beyond to provide a solution. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this Company.

Spoke to Rod about solar analytics and Withings week  he sent his number 1 man our Mark to install - not only was he helpful and diligent in his workmanship he also identified issues with our solar system that was installed by others the team at Western Sydney Solar are passionate about customer care and quality service highly recommend

Rod Grono was the only person who responded to me and I have been very satisfied with his professionalism and quality of service. I would be happy to recommend Rod to anyone seeking electical or solar power services.
